about.title: The Soul of Augeo
about.subtitle: Redefining the horizon of global acquisition through certified integrity and institutional-grade excellence.
about.originsText1: Augeo was born from a singular vision: to bridge the gap between world-class auction houses and the next generation of global connoisseurs. We recognized that the traditional auction model, while prestigious, often lacked the transparency and technological agility required in the digital age.
about.originsText2: By integrating military-grade encryption, institutional-grade financial processing, and a rigorous multi-stage authentication protocol, we've created a 'Gated Marketplace' where integrity is the only currency that matters.

principles.integrityDesc: Every asset passes through a triple-blind verification process before entering the vault.
principles.accessDesc: Connecting the world's most exclusive liquid assets with collectors regardless of geography.
principles.fluidityDesc: Creating a highly-liquid secondary market for ultra-rare items through secure settlement.

cta.title: Join the Executive Council
cta.desc: Augeo is more than a platform—it's a community of discerning buyers and sellers committed to excellence. Start your journey with us today.

howItWorks.title: The Augeo Method
howItWorks.subtitle: Authenticating liquid assets and empowering global collectors through a frictionless 3-stage protocol.

step1.title: Identity Clearance
step1.desc: To maintain the integrity of our gated marketplace, all participants must undergo initial Trust Clearance. This protects the ecosystem from fraudulent activity and ensures a zero-risk environment for high-value transactions.

step2.title: Strategic Acquisition
step2.desc: Once cleared, gain access to live auctions and upcoming drops. Our real-time bidding infrastructure uses low-latency sockets to ensure your bids are captured instantly, even in the final seconds.
step2.point2: Auto-Bidding: Set limits and let the system defend your position.

step3.title: Secure Settlement
step3.desc: Winning bidders enter the settlement phase immediately. Our integration with Stripe Capital ensures institutional-grade fund transfer, followed by insured global logistics for physical assets.
step3.point1: Certificate of Provenance: Every winning bid is closed with a certified, cryptographically signed record of authenticity.

inquiries.title: Still Have Inquiries?
inquiries.desc: Our concierge team is available 24/7 for tailored inquiries regarding high-value acquisitions.

buyersPremium.title: Buyers Premium
buyersPremium.subtitle: A comprehensive guide to our standardized fee structures, designed to maintain the Augeo platform's world-class operational integrity.
buyersPremium.whatIsDesc: The Buyer's Premium is a standardized industry fee added to the 'Hammer Price' of an asset. This premium directly funds our multi-stage authentication, global logistics infrastructure, and cryptographically secure settlement protocols.
buyersPremium.formula: Total Payable = Hammer Price + (Hammer Price × Premium Rate) + Applicable Taxes & Logistics

provisions.title: Key Provisions
provisions.p1: All premiums are settled in the final invoice.
provisions.p2: Rates are subject to specific lot notations.
provisions.p3: The premium is legally part of the final contract.

buyersPremium.logisticsNote: Note: Premiums do not include shipping, insurance, or import duties.

shippingTaxes.title: Logistics & Settlement
shippingTaxes.subtitle: From the vault to your doorstep—insured, authenticated, and cryptographically tracked across 120+ jurisdictions.
shippingTaxes.protocolDesc: Winning bids for physical assets trigger our standardized logistics protocol. We partner with specialized white-glove couriers to ensure the provenance and condition of your acquisition remain pristine during transit.

methods.air: Air Priority: 48-72 hour global transit for watch and jewelry lots.
methods.marine: Marine Fragile: Temperature-controlled sea freight for bulk spirits.
methods.whiteGlove: White Glove: Last-mile home installation for fine art collections.
methods.vault: Vault Pickup: Direct collection from our secure facilities globally.

shippingTaxes.complianceDesc: Taxes and duties are calculated based on the destination of the asset and its classification.
shippingTaxes.customsNote: Customs documentation prepared automatically per lot.

regions.eu: European Union: Standardized VAT applies per member state.
regions.na: North America: Certain art classes exempted from US import duties.
regions.ap: Asia Pacific: Complex duties apply for spirits and luxury tech.
regions.me: Middle East: Exemptions available for Free Trade Zone delivery.

terms.title: Terms of Engagement
terms.subtitle: The contractual architecture governing participation within the Augeo global auction ecosystem.
terms.secure: By using this platform, you agree to these protocols.

s1.title: 1. Guild Membership & Eligibility
s1.p1: Membership to the Augeo platform is a privilege, not a right. All users must maintain 'Active' status through our Trust Clearance protocol. We reserve the right to revoke access to any participant who fails to meet our professional conduct standards or financial commitments.
s1.p2: Participants must be at least 18 years of age and possess the legal capacity to enter into binding financial contracts within their primary jurisdiction.

s2.title: 2. Bidding Sovereignty
s2.p1: A bid constitutes a legally binding contract to purchase the asset at the specified 'Hammer Price' plus all applicable premiums and logistics surcharges. Once a bid is registered in our real-time socket infrastructure, it cannot be withdrawn except under specific conditions verified by our Council.
s2.warning: Warning: Failed commitments resulting from 'bid negligence' will result in a permanent ban from the guild and potential legal action to recover lost premiums.

s3.title: 3. Financial Settlement
s3.p1: All winning bids must be settled within 72 hours of the auction close. Payments are processed through our secure gateway (Stripe Capital). Assets will only enter the Logistics Nexus once funds have reached full 'Settled' status in our accounts.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
s4.p1: All imagery, visual classification data, and technical protocols present on Augeo are the exclusive property of the Guild. Unauthorized reproduction or algorithmic scraping of our catalog data is strictly prohibited.

questions.title: Questions of Law?
questions.desc: Our legal council is available for clarification on complex jurisdictional issues.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Our commitment to the cryptographic protection and absolute privacy of your identity and asset data.

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.p1: In order to facilitate high-value acquisitions, Augeo collects essential identity packets during the Trust Clearance phase. This includes government-issued identification, biometric liveness data, and certified proof of residency.
collection.guaranteeDesc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third-party marketing entities. Your data exists only to ensure the security of the auction ecosystem.

storage.title: Storage & Retention
storage.p1: Identity data is stored in air-gapped, encrypted environments using AES-256 Bit standards. We retain your data only as long as required for jurisdictional compliance and to maintain your Guild Membership status.

cookies.title: Cookie Protocol
cookies.p1: Augeo uses essential session cookies to maintain your login status and ensure the stability of real-time bidding sockets. We do not use intrusive tracking or behavioral profiling scripts.

faq.title: Privacy FAQ
faq.a1: Yes, 100% of identity packets are pre-encrypted before storage.
faq.a2: Only your Guild Rank is visible. Your real identity remains hidden.
faq.a3: Yes, per GDPR/CCPA protocols, barring active financial commitments.

trust.title: Trust Verified
trust.desc: Our privacy framework is audited quarterly by leading cybersecurity agencies.

footer.title: Security Matters
footer.desc: For specific data access requests or privacy inquiries, please contact our Compliance Officer.
